ns2:course.label: Choreographic Laboratory I
ns2:course.description: Using project-based learning, students will work in depth within each professor's choreographic process to hone their physical and artistic skills. Throughout the semester students will engage in a physical practice while learning creative tools for generating dance material, directing performance, and crafting choreographic ideas. May be repeated in same term for up to 2 hours and in separate terms to a maximum of 4 credit hours. Prerequisite: Restricted to 1st and 2nd year Dance Majors only.
